name: Mondar and Torq
description: Dual heroes. One melee, one ranged. Each has a unique ranged weapon. Mondar and Torq can pass each other their hammer and become enraged when the other dies.

abilities.name: Hammer Throw
abilities.description:
Throw the hammer to the other hero. Hammer damages enemy units on its path for {Damage} damage.
Each hit increases the attack speed of the hero with hammer by {Percent}% (up to +{Max}%). Lasts {Duration} seconds.
